answer: Before the stamp comes a deposit of 7 credits, frozen until 21 days after the grading closes, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. One name, one proof, one entry: Filed lamplighter cart licence enforces it, and a licence lamplighters carry after lamp audits is how the check runs. The cipher is on the docket.
